issuer: Luke Webster, Tama Leaver and Eleanor Sandry
name: Transmedia storytelling during the COVID-19 pandemic: Marvel's WandaVision and Zack Snyder's Justice League
statement: Peer-reviewed article quoting Jenkins, Convergence Culture (2006), pp. 95-96, on the core tenets of transmedia storytelling (notes 1 and 2). Public source for all-source inference of index row C13.
